LES1.label: Access Issues

LES1.1.label: Email Address Issues
LES1.1.description: Problems arising from incorrect or unrecognized email addresses used for registration or subscriptions.

LES1.2.label: Subscription Access Problems
LES1.2.description: Issues related to accessing services due to subscription status, including confusion over trial periods and active subscriptions.

LES1.3.label: Activation and Verification Issues
LES1.3.description: Concerns regarding activation links, verification emails, and related errors that prevent access.

LES1.4.label: General Access Issues
LES1.4.description: Cases that fall within access problems but do not fit any specific leaf above.

LES1.description: This category covers problems related to accessing accounts, subscriptions, or services. It includes issues with email addresses, subscriptions, and activation links.

LES2.label: Account Management

LES2.1.label: Registration Issues
LES2.1.description: Problems encountered during the registration process, including missing pages and errors in account creation.

LES2.2.label: Account Activation Problems
LES2.2.description: Issues related to activating accounts, including missing activation links and prompts.

LES2.3.label: Password Issues
LES2.3.description: Concerns regarding password acceptance, resets, and related errors that hinder account access.

LES2.4.label: General Account Management Issues
LES2.4.description: Cases that fall within account management but do not fit any specific leaf above.

LES2.description: This category encompasses issues related to account setup, registration, and management. It includes problems with user activation and account levels.
